[[File:Icon-creature.png|40px]]

A '''Creature''' is a [[Star Wars CCG]] card type for non-character living threats (for example a wampa or rancor). Creatures are not [[Character]]s and are not [[Vehicle|Vehicles]] — a [[Creature Vehicle]] (Bantha, tauntaun) is a vehicle subtype.
